gates.owner: The fictional adult, their visible face, the console and meter fixtures, and the framed radio dish within one control-cabin view
required_components: The adult face remains identifiable at environmental portrait scale
A task-specific console, meter faces, and radio dish establish the actual control cabin
The adult right hand connects to the console selector as part of the power-test task
The frame retains enough cabin and dish context to explain the task
gates.confusion_boundary: A face-only crop, arbitrary pasted background, or control room without person-fixture connection fails.
gates.pass_rule: Every named component must be visible for this owner in the same native image; any missing, ambiguous, substituted, or partial component is fail.

gates.owner: The adult right hand, red knurled selector, and amber status lamps on the same console
required_components: The specific right-hand turning action is visible
The red selector target is visible with that hand in the same frame
The hand visibly grips the selector through a plausible wrist-arm path
Amber lamps on that console show an immediate state change linked to the turned selector
gates.confusion_boundary: A held unrelated object, hovering hand, decorative lamps, or disconnected result fails.
gates.pass_rule: Every named component must be visible for this owner in the same native image; any missing, ambiguous, substituted, or partial component is fail.

gates.owner: The red selector grip, its small polished ridges, the neighboring intact coating, and the selector base material

The selector edge and local highlights remain coherent beneath the worn patches
gates.confusion_boundary: Uniform grunge, floating marks, or wear unrelated to finger contact fails.
gates.pass_rule: Every named component must be visible for this owner in the same native image; any missing, ambiguous, substituted, or partial component is fail.

gates.owner: Adult right hand, red selector, and amber status lamps on the same console

gates.owner: Fictional adult face and hair compared only to visible appearance in the attached portrait
required_components: Clearly adult-looking face visible in three-quarter view
